sources.name: National Park Service webcams (NPS Data API /webcams + nps.gov image URLs)
sources.access: API (JSON, 288 webcams nationally, lat/lon, status, isStreaming, page url). The API's images[] is empty for live cams, so the still-image URL is read once from each camera's nps.gov page (img#webcamRefreshImage), or for air-quality cams from /featurecontent/ard/webcams/json/{site}json.txt; cache it, refresh weekly
sources.key_needed: yes for the listing: free api.data.gov key (Chris registers). This build used the public DEMO_KEY (10 requests/h), fine for a one-off only. The image URLs themselves need no key
sources.image_url_pattern: mostly https://www.nps.gov/webcams-{park}/{name}.jpg or https://www.nps.gov/featurecontent/ard/webcams/images/{file}; some partner hosts (webcam.io, pixelcaster, glacier.org, weather.gov)
sources.count_in_boxes: 163 listed in boxes; 15 inactive, 17 streaming-only, junk/DOT/USGS-duplicate entries removed; 115 still images checked, 107 load OK, 100 fresh <24 h; by region {'sierra': 32, 'utco': 34, 'imw': 15, 'pnw': 26}. 8 failed (mostly 403 AccessDenied = file gone: Glacier Apgar 2/Night Sky, John Day Painted Hills, Lava Beds, Big Hole, El Morro, 2 webcam.io Parashant cams); 6 records repeat another record's image (kept once), so 101 unique NPS cams in cams
sources.kinds: Rainier (Paradise, Sunrise, Camp Muir/Schurman, Carbon), Olympic Hurricane Ridge, Glacier (Lake McDonald, Logan Pass, Many Glacier, St Mary), Yellowstone (Old Faithful etc.), Grand Teton, Yosemite, Crater Lake, Lassen, Sequoia, Redwood, Rocky Mountain, Zion, Bryce, Arches, Grand Canyon, Great Basin area, Dinosaur, Parashant, Guadalupe Mts, Channel Islands, Joshua Tree, Death Valley area, air-quality visibility cams
sources.terms: NPS: most NPS web content is public domain (https://www.nps.gov/aboutus/disclaimer.htm); partner-hosted images carry their hosts' terms; honour credit lines. NPS API docs and key signup: https://www.nps.gov/subjects/developer/get-started.htm
sources.attribution: Credit National Park Service (plus partner credit if shown); link the camera's nps.gov page
sources.overlap_alertwest: none; a few NPS-listed entries are DOT (AZ511, UDOT) or USGS HIVIS cams and were removed
sources.reason: Best park coverage and stable image URLs. The key is only for the listing (positions, status); images hotlink keylessly. Because image URLs rarely change, the page-scrape step can run weekly, not hourly.

sources.name: Windy Webcams API v3
sources.access: JSON API, header x-windy-api-key; free tier: limit 50 per call, offset max 1000 (so tile the boxes), categories filter (airport, beach, city, coast, lake, mountain, river, sportArea, traffic, village, ...)
sources.key_needed: yes: free key from https://api.windy.com/keys (Chris registers)
sources.image_url_pattern: images.current.* URLs carry a token that expires: docs say 10 min on the free tier (pricing page says 15 min), 24 h on Professional (EUR 9,990/yr). Keyless alternative for the popup: iframe https://webcams.windy.com/webcams/public/embed/player/{webcamId}/day (checked: HTTP 200, no X-Frame-Options)
sources.count_in_boxes: unknown: the API refuses requests without a key (403 'Missing Header x-windy-api-key'). windy_count.py counts by region and category once Chris has a key
sources.kinds: aggregator of third-party cams: ski areas, towns, lakes, beaches, airports, plus many traffic cams (filter category 'traffic')
sources.terms: https://api.windy.com/webcams/terms: link every image to windy.com, show 'Webcams provided by Windy.com' courtesy, use only API-provided URLs, no stretching; free plan 'Image url validity is limited to 15 minutes' (pricing page)
sources.attribution: 'Webcams provided by Windy.com' plus a link to the webcam's windy.com page on every image
sources.overlap_alertwest: partial: Windy includes many DOT traffic cams (drop category traffic); unknown overlap otherwise
sources.verdict: use with Chris's key, but not as a plain hourly
sources.reason: Free-tier image URLs die in 10-15 min, far shorter than the hourly rebuild. Workable designs: (a) hourly list of ids/positions with the key, popup embeds Windy's day-timelapse player iframe (has ads on free tier); or (b) a Cloudflare Worker holding the key returns a fresh image URL when a popup opens (within ToS: uses API URLs, links to windy.com). Many Windy cams duplicate provider cams (Roundshot etc.) that may be hotlinkable directly.

samples_checked.note: player iframe, not an image; image URLs could not be tested without a key

USGS NIMS also carries 4 USGS coastal cams in the Sierra box (Santa Cruz Dream Inn C1/C2, Sunset State Beach C1/C2): surf/beach views, included in cams as category 'other'.

NWS office webcam pages (https://www.weather.gov/slc/Cameras, https://www.weather.gov/sew/webcams, https://www.weather.gov/riw/cms_webcams_qview, https://www.weather.gov/cys/webcams) aggregate third-party cams 'used with permission', mostly DOT; hand-pick the non-DOT ones. NWS Flagstaff's own cam https://www.weather.gov/images/fgz/webcam/camera1.jpg loads (200) but was 3 months stale on 2026-09-26.

NAV CANADA MetCam (https://www.metcam.navcanada.ca/) has aviation weather cams across southern BC/Alberta inside the pnw box, not in AlertWest; site is 'All rights reserved': ask NAV CANADA before using.
Parks Canada (Rogers Pass, Kootenay/Yoho, Waterton) cams sit inside the pnw box; not evaluated here.
USGS HIVIS hides 63 in-box cameras (hideCam=true); USGS may show them on request if any sit on rivers Chris cares about.
NPS: 17 in-box park cams are streaming-only (YouTube/HLS) and 15 are marked Inactive; these could get a link-only marker.

Ashcam re-hosts several ski-area views (Timberline summit/Palmer, Mt Bachelor, Crystal Roundshot, Snowcrest Shasta, Mt Hood Meadows): if the ski agent has the direct URLs, prefer those and drop the USGS copies to keep credit clean.
